label: Parte 1
subtitle: 3 preguntas personales · 30 seg cada una

meta.formato: 3 preguntas del MISMO tema en escalada

objetivo: Las 3 preguntas del Aptis Parte 1 suelen ir del MISMO tema en escalada: pregunta 1 PRESENTE (describir), pregunta 2 PASADO (tu experiencia), pregunta 3 FUTURO/HIPÓTESIS (preferencia o cambio). Tres plantillas distintas, ~75 palabras cada una.

patron_oficial.descripcion: Las 3 preguntas escalan en complejidad gramatical: presente → pasado → futuro/hipótesis.
ejemplo_real: Q1 (presente): Tell me about your hometown.
Q2 (pasado): Tell me about the last time you went back.
Q3 (futuro/hipótesis): What would you change about your town if you could?

plantillas.label: Plantilla A · PRESENTE
plantillas.uso: Pregunta directa sobre cómo es algo. Tiempo verbal: presente simple + presente perfecto.

sujeto.ayuda: El sujeto de la pregunta (my hometown, my job, my family…)

opciones.texto: my hometown
my job
my family
my daily routine
my favourite food

descripcion.ayuda: 2-3 palabras describiendo. Adjetivos B2 mejor que 'good' o 'nice'.

opciones.texto: a small but charming coastal town
quite a close-knit and supportive one
really demanding but rewarding
pretty packed from morning to night

pasos.title: Dos detalles concretos

conector_inicial.texto: What I love most about it

alternativas.texto: What I love most about it is
One of the things I appreciate is

plantilla_segmentos.texto: What I love most about it is

detalle1.ayuda: Algo específico y memorable del tema.

opciones.texto: the friendly atmosphere
its rich cultural heritage
the flexibility it gives me
how peaceful and laid-back it is

experiencia.ayuda: Algo que has hecho/vivido relacionado con esto.

opciones.texto: living there for over five years
working in this field for nearly a decade
doing this routine since I moved in
passionate about it for as long as I can remember

pasos.trick: Mete un presente perfecto ('I've been + ing') = marca B2 instantánea.

pasos.title: Cierre con valoración

alternativas.texto: At the end of the day,

cierre.ayuda: Cómo te hace sentir o por qué importa.

opciones.texto: it really makes my day
I wouldn't change it for the world
it brings me a real sense of belonging
it's something I genuinely value

pasos.trick: Cierre limpio con idiom B2/C1. No te quedes a medias.

plantillas.label: Plantilla B · PASADO
plantillas.uso: Pregunta sobre tu experiencia o última vez que algo pasó. Tiempo verbal: pasado simple + pasado continuo.

pasos.title: Contexto temporal

periodo.ayuda: Cuándo pasó. Cuanto más concreto, mejor.

opciones.texto: weekend
summer
month
year
Christmas
went back to visit my family
decided to take up a new hobby
travelled to Italy with my partner
cooked a homemade paella for my friends
took part in a local marathon

pasos.trick: Acción concreta = imagen mental clara para el evaluador.

pasos.title: Acción en curso + detalle

alternativas.texto: While I was there, I was

continuo.ayuda: Acción en curso. Pasado continuo = marca B2.

opciones.texto: walking around the old town at sunset
catching up with my best friend over coffee
preparing dinner for the whole family
exploring a small village in the mountains
it felt absolutely refreshing
it took a real load off my mind
I was completely amazed
it brought back wonderful memories

pasos.trick: Pasado simple + continuo en frases seguidas = marca B2 alta inmediata.

pasos.title: Reflexión / aprendizaje

leccion.ayuda: Qué aprendiste o por qué importa.

opciones.texto: how much I miss those moments
balance is essential in everything I do
small things really make all the difference
stepping out of your comfort zone opens your mind

pasos.trick: Reflexión = madurez discursiva. Examinadores valoran cierre con sentido.

plantillas.label: Plantilla C · FUTURO / HIPÓTESIS
plantillas.uso: Pregunta sobre lo que harías, cambiarías o preferirías. Tiempo verbal: condicional 2 + futuro.

pasos.title: Posicionamiento

conector_inicial.texto: To be honest, if I had to

alternativas.texto: To be honest, if I had to

plantilla_segmentos.texto: To be honest, if I had to

verbo_hip.ayuda: Tras 'had to' va infinitivo sin to.

opciones.texto: choose
change something
pick one
make a decision
go for a bigger and greener city
invest in better public transport
try something completely different
set clearer boundaries in my routine

pasos.trick: 'If I had to + would' = condicional 2 bien construido. Marca B2 limpia.
pasos.warning: 'If I would' = ERROR. Siempre 'If I HAD to + would'.

pasos.title: Razón sólida

razon.ayuda: Por qué es la mejor opción para ti.

opciones.texto: it would give me much more flexibility
it really suits my personality
I've always thrived in that kind of environment

refuerzo.ayuda: Algo más que apoya tu elección.

opciones.texto: honestly, it just feels right
it would broaden my horizons enormously
it would make a real difference in my life

pasos.trick: Doble argumento (razón + refuerzo) = densidad discursiva B2.

conector_inicial.texto: At the end of the day,

alternativas.texto: At the end of the day,

plantilla_segmentos.texto: At the end of the day,

opciones.texto: it's all about finding the right balance
you have to follow your gut
small choices make a big difference
I genuinely believe it would pay off

kits_universales.label: Phrasal verbs B2 para todas las plantillas

temas.label: Hometown / Tu ciudad

bloque_a: Tell me about your hometown.
What is your town like?
Where do you live?
Describe the area where you live.
What kind of place is your city?
bloque_b: Tell me about the last time you went back to your hometown.
When did you last visit your favourite place in your city?
Tell me about a special moment you remember in your town.
What's the most memorable thing you've done in your area recently?
When did you last show your town to a visitor?
bloque_c: What would you change about your town if you could?
Would you like to live somewhere else in the future?
If you could move anywhere, where would it be?
How do you think your town will change in the next 10 years?
Would you recommend your town to a visitor?

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my hometown is a small but charming coastal town. What I love most about it is the friendly atmosphere. I've been living there for over five years. All in all, it really makes my day.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last weekend I went back to visit my family. I remember I was walking around the old town at sunset and it felt absolutely refreshing. It made me realise how much I miss those moments.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to choose, I would go for a bigger and greener city. The main reason is that it would give me much more flexibility, and honestly, it just feels right. At the end of the day, it's all about finding the right balance.

bloque_a: What do you like doing in your free time?

bloque_b: When did you start your favourite hobby?
Tell me about the last time you enjoyed your hobby.
What did you do last weekend?
Have you tried any new hobbies recently?
Tell me about a hobby you used to do as a child.
bloque_c: Would you like to try a new hobby in the future?
If you had more free time, what would you do?
Would you recommend your hobby to others?
Do you think hobbies are important?
What hobby would you love to learn?

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my favourite hobby is really demanding but rewarding. What I love most about it is the flexibility it gives me. I've been doing this routine since I moved in. All in all, it's something I genuinely value.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last weekend I decided to take up a new hobby. I remember I was preparing dinner for the whole family and it brought back wonderful memories. It made me realise how small things really make all the difference.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to choose a new hobby, I would try something completely different. The main reason is that it really suits my personality, and it would broaden my horizons enormously. In a nutshell, small choices make a big difference.

temas.label: Family

bloque_b: Tell me about the last time you spent time with your family.

Have you visited your family recently?
bloque_c: How important is family for you?
Would you like to live closer to or farther from your family?
How will your family change in the future?
If you could spend more time with your family, what would you do?
Do you think families spend enough time together nowadays?

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my family is quite a close-knit and supportive one. What I love most about it is the friendly atmosphere. I've been living with them for over five years. All in all, I wouldn't change it for the world.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last Christmas I went back to visit my family. I remember I was catching up with my best friend over coffee and it brought back wonderful memories. It made me realise balance is essential in everything I do.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to change something, I would go for living closer to them. The main reason is that it would give me much more flexibility, and it would make a real difference in my life. At the end of the day, it's all about finding the right balance.

What do you study?
Describe your work.

bloque_b: Tell me about the last time you had a busy day at work.

bloque_c: Would you change anything about your job?

If you could change career, what would you do?

Would you recommend your profession to others?

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my job is really demanding but rewarding. What I love most about it is the flexibility it gives me. I've been working in this field for nearly a decade. All in all, it brings me a real sense of belonging.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last month I had a really demanding project. I remember I was preparing reports late at night and I was completely amazed by how much I learnt. It made me realise small things really make all the difference.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to change something, I would invest in better remote work options. The main reason is that I've always thrived in that kind of environment, and it would broaden my horizons enormously. In a nutshell, it's all about finding the right balance.

temas.label: Food

bloque_a: What's your favourite food?

bloque_b: Tell me about the last time you cooked something special.

Would you recommend the food from your country to a visitor?

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my favourite food is homemade paella, which is quite a traditional one. What I love most about it is its rich cultural heritage. I've been cooking it for as long as I can remember. All in all, it's something I genuinely value.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last weekend I cooked a homemade paella for my friends. I remember I was preparing dinner for the whole family and it brought back wonderful memories. It made me realise how much small things really make all the difference.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to pick one cuisine forever, I would go for Italian. The main reason is that it really suits my personality, and honestly, it just feels right. At the end of the day, you have to follow your gut.

bloque_b: What did you do yesterday?

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my daily routine is pretty packed from morning to night. What I love most about it is the flexibility it gives me. I've been doing this routine since I moved in. All in all, it's something I genuinely value.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last weekend I went hiking with friends. I remember I was walking around the old town at sunset and it felt absolutely refreshing. It made me realise balance is essential in everything I do.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to change something, I would set clearer boundaries in my routine. The main reason is that it would give me much more flexibility, and it would make a real difference in my life. In a nutshell, small choices make a big difference.

temas.respuesta_modelo_a: Well, in my case, my favourite type of holiday is quite an adventurous one. What I love most about it is how peaceful and laid-back it is. I've been passionate about travelling for as long as I can remember. All in all, it brings me a real sense of belonging.
temas.respuesta_modelo_b: Actually, last summer I travelled to Italy with my partner. I remember I was exploring a small village in the mountains and I was completely amazed. It made me realise stepping out of your comfort zone opens your mind.
temas.respuesta_modelo_c: To be honest, if I had to choose a dream destination, I would go for Japan. The main reason is that I've always thrived in that kind of environment, and it would broaden my horizons enormously. At the end of the day, you have to follow your gut.
